key_idea: Build a symmetric model in which every non-wellorderable image of the label set A is in bijection with A, and make those bijections coherent using a custom left-cancellative monoid of diagrams, exact availability fibers, and a selector based on Cohen generics that chooses cosets of a countable residual stabilizer.
reason: The reduction from the quotient classification (1) together with SVC(A) and AC_WO to full PP is clean, and it is a real conceptual insight. The coherence construction, however, needs a heavy bespoke apparatus: a monoid with heights, costs, probes, merges and towers, followed by fiber counting, component stabilizers and coset selection. That apparatus spans many lemma chains and buries the reason the model works under extensive technical bookkeeping.
